name: ECB Data Portal API
summary: Keyless SDMX REST API for ECB exchange rates, interest rates, monetary and banking statistics.
description: Official ECB statistical data: euro foreign exchange reference rates, key interest rates, monetary aggregates, balance of payments, bank lending, inflation (HICP) and securities. Series are addressed by dataflow plus a dot-separated key; supports SDMX-JSON, CSV and SDMX-ML, with lastNObservations and period filters.

example.response_excerpt: {"header": {"id": "1656feac-...", "sender": {"id": "ECB"}}, "dataSets": [{"series": {"0:0:0:0:0": {"observations": {"0": [1.1214, 0, 0, null, null]}}}}], "structure": "(dimensions: currency, denom, type; time period 2026-11-10)"}

license.name: Free reuse with source acknowledgement (ECB copyright policy)

coverage.geographic: Euro area and EU; FX from 1999

agent_notes: Series keys like D.USD.EUR.SP00.A (frequency.currency.denominator.type.variation) must be learned from the dataflow structure. Prefer format=csvdata over SDMX-JSON, which is verbose. The EXR flow gives daily euro reference rates around 16:00 CET.
caveats: SDMX-JSON is verbose; csvdata is easier for agents (verified).
Update frequency differs per dataflow: FX daily, other series monthly or quarterly.
The response excerpt is abbreviated; the structure section is summarised rather than quoted.
